name: GLEIF LEI data
specific_judgment: Accounting parent relationship does not prove ownership percentage; use LEI as entity bridge.

name: OpenCorporates
specific_judgment: Use jurisdiction plus registration number to resolve a supplier; aggregated corporate records need confirmation at the issuing registry and historical dates.

name: Open Ownership Register
specific_judgment: Beneficial-owner statements can supply ownership paths only with statement dates, interests and source provenance; an unverified declaration is not the final owner.

name: UK Companies House Public Data API
specific_judgment: PSC control bands and notification dates need underlying share evidence for OFAC ownership; officer appointment data cannot substitute for ownership.

name: SEC EDGAR
specific_judgment: CIK anchors the reporting issuer, not every named subsidiary. Read the exact filing passage and distinguish contract backlog, revenue and payments.

name: Japan EDINET
specific_judgment: EDINET identifiers anchor Japanese filers; obtain the specific securities report and local entity identifiers before cross-border sanctions screening.

name: ASIC company dataset
specific_judgment: ASIC company number and status can establish Australian identity; free company extracts do not automatically include complete beneficial ownership or historic status.

name: Australian Business Register bulk extract
specific_judgment: ABN is not interchangeable with ACN. Resolve sole traders versus incorporated entities before attaching awards or sanctions to an Australian business.

name: Corporations Canada open data
specific_judgment: Federal Canadian corporation records exclude provincially incorporated firms; an absent federal entry cannot establish a fictitious supplier.

name: France INPI National Business Register
specific_judgment: French registry legal identifiers support identity; named officers or representatives are not necessarily owners and beneficial-owner access may differ by route.

name: India MCA company master data
specific_judgment: Indian master-data identity/status supports an MCA company match, but names and current status do not reconstruct officers or ownership at an earlier award.

name: New Zealand Companies Register API
specific_judgment: New Zealand registry numbers must be tied to exact corporate forms and effective dates; authenticated API availability remains a separate gate.

name: New Zealand Business Number bulk data
specific_judgment: NZBN may cover multiple business types; verify the legal entity behind a supplier rather than treating every business number as incorporated-company equity.

name: Singapore ACRA registered entities
specific_judgment: Singapore UEN anchors an entity; incorporation/status data alone cannot establish beneficial ownership or whether an award was performed.

name: Hong Kong Companies Registry open data
specific_judgment: Hong Kong business names require exact registry identity; free data and full historical company documents have different access and evidentiary scope.

name: South Africa CIPC API
specific_judgment: South African CIPC access is a credential/terms gate; match registration numbers and specific legal persons before inferring related bidders.

name: German Company Register
specific_judgment: German court/register jurisdiction is part of the key; a bare registration number is not nationally unique, and official document versions matter.

name: OpenRegister Germany
specific_judgment: OpenRegister aggregation is a search aid for German identity; corroborate the actual court-register entry and do not count it as independent ownership evidence.

name: EU Business Registers Interconnection System (BRIS)
specific_judgment: BRIS connects national registries; lack of a search hit does not establish nonexistence across differing search interfaces and coverage.

name: Italy Registro Imprese
specific_judgment: Italian company-role fields must not be promoted into ownership percentages; retrieve the actual legal interest record for a control hypothesis.

name: Netherlands KVK APIs
specific_judgment: KVK identity routes may be paid or restricted; branch identifiers and legal entity identifiers need separation before award grouping.

name: Brazil CVM open data
specific_judgment: CVM identifies Brazilian securities filers; a listed issuer and a domestic operating subsidiary can have distinct CNPJ identifiers and reporting scopes.

name: OpenSanctions
specific_judgment: Sanctions aggregation shares upstream lists; overlap cannot independently corroborate a listing.

name: US OFAC Sanctions List Service
specific_judgment: OFAC identity, applicable program, listing interval and exceptions must all be established; a name overlap is only a lead and vessel/company IMO namespaces differ.

name: UK Sanctions List
specific_judgment: UK sanctions must use the UK legal scope and effective list version; do not transfer the OFAC ownership rule to UK restrictions.

name: EU consolidated financial sanctions list
specific_judgment: EU list overlap requires the relevant regulation and dates; a consolidated identifier does not establish that every proposed transaction is prohibited.

name: UN Security Council Consolidated List
specific_judgment: UN designations need the applicable domestic implementation for a transaction question; list membership alone is not a universal banking prohibition.

name: Canadian Autonomous Sanctions List
specific_judgment: Canadian autonomous sanctions require the specific regulation, effective dates and exceptions; a consolidated list is not the operative legal text.

name: Australian Sanctions Consolidated List
specific_judgment: Australian consolidated sanctions require the applicable regime and conduct nexus; retain distinct person/entity identity and historical listing evidence.

name: World Bank debarred firms and individuals
specific_judgment: World Bank debarment scope and dates must reach the financed procurement; matching a project borrower does not establish a sanctioned supplier award.

name: IDB sanctioned firms and individuals
specific_judgment: IDB sanctions require institution/project coverage and exact sanctioned affiliates; cross-debarment cannot be presumed from a similar World Bank name.

name: FinCEN SAR Stats
specific_judgment: SAR category/location trends might contextualize a DOJ enforcement wave; statistics contain no named subjects and filing location is not conduct location.

name: FATF mutual-evaluation ratings
specific_judgment: FATF country/recommendation ratings might frame AML oversight, but cannot join US SAR filing locations into a country-level outcome test.

name: US DOJ corporate enforcement actions
specific_judgment: Read DOJ resolution documents for admitted facts, defendant identity and dates; announcement headlines cannot establish liability of every affiliate.

name: Stanford FCPA Clearinghouse
specific_judgment: The FCPA clearinghouse can locate underlying cases; distinguish an investigation, charge, settlement and final finding before relating public funding.

name: Good Jobs First Violation Tracker
specific_judgment: Violation Tracker aggregates heterogeneous penalties; deduplicate shared enforcement actions and verify the original finding and liable subsidiary.

name: SEC litigation releases
specific_judgment: SEC litigation releases describe different procedural stages; alleged conduct and settled findings need separation before constructing a repeat-offender test.

name: US EPA ECHO web services
specific_judgment: ECHO facility IDs identify regulatory facilities, not company equity. Validate operator history, exact hazard and geographic coverage of the second source.

name: INTERPOL Red Notices
specific_judgment: Wanted-person notice is not conviction; officer identity and current notice status require exact biographical proof.

name: ICIJ Offshore Leaks Database
specific_judgment: Offshore leaks contain dated roles in selected records; an intermediary is not necessarily an owner, and current sanctions identity needs corroboration.

name: OCCRP Aleph
specific_judgment: An exact company identifier in a specified Aleph collection could substantiate a dated role of an OFAC entity; Aleph itself is an index, not independent evidence.

name: Tax Justice Network Data Portal and Financial Secrecy Index
specific_judgment: Secrecy-index scores are composite context; retain the exact component and vintage rather than claiming high rank proves evasion by a named company.

name: OECD country-by-country reporting statistics
specific_judgment: Country-by-country statistics describe reporting multinational populations; jurisdictional profit/activity mismatch cannot identify an individual tax scheme.

name: IRS FATCA Foreign Financial Institution list
specific_judgment: FATCA registration can supply a narrow institution-status check, never proof of a financial transaction.

name: IRS Form 990 bulk filings
specific_judgment: Form 990 EIN identifies the charity, while schedules distinguish officers, grantees and contractors; disclosed related parties can be lawful.

name: Canada registered charities open data
specific_judgment: Canadian charity business numbers and fiscal periods support exact identity, but donor visibility differs from grants and officer disclosures.

name: HM Land Registry Overseas Companies Ownership Data
specific_judgment: Overseas-company land titles establish registered legal proprietors within England/Wales coverage; frozen ownership can remain on title without a new transaction.

name: OpenLux
specific_judgment: OpenLux names and dated roles need original registry support; historic directors or agents cannot establish present ultimate ownership.

name: Have I Been Pwned
specific_judgment: A public-interest organization domain could delimit a breach-notification question, but an email hit cannot prove employment, compromise date or current control.

name: WikiLeaks Public Library of US Diplomacy (PlusD)
specific_judgment: A cable with the same original identifier in PlusD and a lawful State Department release could expose differing redactions or contradictory official chronology.

name: Distributed Denial of Secrets
specific_judgment: A specified public-interest release might contain a contract contradicted by an issuer filing, but release-specific fields establish no universal join or trustworthy predicate.

name: Open Contracting Data Registry
specific_judgment: Open Contracting is a registry of releases; select a jurisdiction and lifecycle stage, preserve OCID and distinguish tender, award and contract.

name: EU TED Search API
specific_judgment: TED buyer/procedure/lot identifiers can anchor competition review; winner names need national corporate identifiers and notices may amend earlier values.

name: USAspending API
specific_judgment: USAspending generated award IDs retrieve actions; obligations are not payments and interval searches may return much older awards.

name: SAM.gov Contract Data API
specific_judgment: SAM contract actions need award/action keys and effective dates; amendments and agency identifiers can otherwise double-count awards.

name: Brazil PNCP
specific_judgment: PNCP CNPJ recipient identifiers offer a stronger entity route, but procurement stages and amendments still determine whether an award exists.

name: IATI Datastore
specific_judgment: IATI activity IDs and transaction types distinguish commitments from disbursements; organization/project locations must not be mistaken for delivery sites.

name: World Bank Projects & Operations
specific_judgment: World Bank project IDs support document joins, not supplier awards by themselves; project index status and dates may be stale.

name: World Bank Finances
specific_judgment: World Bank finances use specific loans/funds/currencies; disbursement, commitment and repayment totals need their own definitions and project crosswalks.

name: Inter-American Development Bank Open Data
specific_judgment: IDB project identifiers can anchor purpose and location; public project descriptions do not automatically expose every contractor or actual delivery milestone.

name: EBRD Project Summary Documents
specific_judgment: EBRD summaries are project disclosures rather than full procurement or payment ledgers; retrieve exact financed scope and updated project documents.

name: EU Financial Transparency System
specific_judgment: EU Financial Transparency beneficiary names need legal-entity resolution and fiscal scope; commitments to programs may not be beneficiary cash received.

name: EU Cohesion Open Data
specific_judgment: Regional cohesion allocations versus prosperity need beneficiary geography, eligibility formula and population denominators.

name: AidData datasets
specific_judgment: AidData geocoding precision varies; national or headquarters points must not support local conflict, election or wealth comparisons.

name: OECD development-finance statistics
specific_judgment: If the same donor project reports disbursements in OECD and IATI, reconcile the overlapping annual amounts before interpreting an aid shortfall.

name: OCHA Financial Tracking Service
specific_judgment: OCHA FTS tracks reported humanitarian flows; donor pledges, commitments and paid contributions are different stages and reporting is incomplete.

name: US ForeignAssistance.gov
specific_judgment: An award identifier shared with USAspending could reveal whether foreign-assistance totals double-count actions or describe different program allocations.

name: Grants.gov APIs
specific_judgment: Opportunity notices do not establish awards; procurement lifecycle IDs and actual award decisions are missing.

name: UN Comtrade
specific_judgment: Comtrade reporter/partner/product/flow/period form a directional tuple; mirror checks reverse both countries and import/export and align classifications.

name: Eurostat Comext
specific_judgment: Comext includes EU and non-EU series; select the actual EU-member reciprocal series and harmonize valuation and reporting calendars.

name: Global Fishing Watch APIs
specific_judgment: Global Fishing Watch AIS-derived activity is modeled and credentialed; identity and coverage gaps prevent equating a gap or trip with illegal fishing/trade.

name: IMO GISIS
specific_judgment: GISIS has distinct IMO ship and company numbers; identical-looking digits cannot bridge those namespaces, and module access varies.

name: Equasis
specific_judgment: Equasis registration/provider terms are an access gate; company roles and ship ownership history must be resolved at event time.

name: Paris MoU inspection and detention data
specific_judgment: Paris MoU requires storage/reuse authorization; detention/inspection supplies an event, not proof of cargo movement or sanctions breach.

name: Tokyo MoU inspection and detention data
specific_judgment: Tokyo MoU inspection records need authorized access and exact ship/date matching; inspection selection makes absence uninformative.

name: OpenSky Network
specific_judgment: OpenSky transponder coverage is incomplete; a dated ICAO-address-to-aircraft bridge is required and a track does not identify passengers.

name: ADS-B Exchange data products
specific_judgment: ADS-B Exchange products may be paid; do not assume earlier budgets authorize access, and transponder tracks cannot establish trip purpose.

name: FAA aircraft registry bulk download
specific_judgment: FAA serial, tail and ICAO identifiers need historical crosswalks because registrations can be reused; registrant may be a trustee.

name: UNOOSA Register of Objects Launched into Outer Space
specific_judgment: Space registration and catalog designators permit piece-level comparison after authority and historical coverage checks.

name: CelesTrak GP orbital data
specific_judgment: Orbit catalog provides object identifiers but current elements do not demonstrate past operations.

name: Space-Track.org
specific_judgment: Space-Track supplies orbital catalog data under its own registration/terms. Cross-check full object identifiers and observation epoch with CelesTrak, recognizing potentially shared upstream observations; not independent proof of satellite operation. Earlier checkpoint mistakenly described this source as radio allocation.

name: SIPRI Arms Transfers Database
specific_judgment: SIPRI transfers describe delivery estimates and trend-indicator values, not market prices; weapon-specific end-use tracing needs additional evidence.

name: UN Register of Conventional Arms
specific_judgment: UN arms reporting is voluntary/uneven; a missing transfer report cannot establish concealment without reporting coverage and category rules.

name: US DSCA Major Arms Sales archive
specific_judgment: DSCA major-sale notices are proposed authorizations, not proof of signed contract, shipment or final dollar value.

name: EU arms-export online database
specific_judgment: EU military-list categories, licensing and actual-export measures differ; harmonize the exact reported quantity before linking conflict context.

name: ENAAT EU Export Data Browser
specific_judgment: ENAAT can make EU export reporting easier to inspect; agreement with the official EU source is not a second observation of arms deliveries.

name: UK strategic export licensing statistics
specific_judgment: UK strategic-export statistics separate licence types and destinations; open licences and approved values are not shipment totals.

name: SIPRI Military Expenditure Database
specific_judgment: For one NATO member and year, reconcile a consequential defence-spending discrepancy with SIPRI after matching currency and scope.

name: NATO defence-expenditure tables
specific_judgment: NATO categories could locate why headline national defence spending differs from another series, without treating different definitions as hidden expenditure.

name: IMF PortWatch
specific_judgment: Modeled port activity and customs trade use different quantities and timing; vessel cargo evidence needed.

name: ACLED
specific_judgment: ACLED coordinates and dates carry precision/coding limits; event count is not a uniform death count, and original reports must be read.

name: UCDP downloads and API
specific_judgment: UCDP conflict thresholds and event definitions differ from broad violence feeds; unmatched records may be legitimately outside scope.

name: Airwars civilian-harm archive
specific_judgment: Airwars civilian-harm assessments vary in evidentiary strength; preserve incident certainty and do not use damage imagery to assign perpetrator alone.

name: Global Terrorism Database
specific_judgment: GTD definition and historic collection changes affect event comparisons; a terror classification is not a universal legal finding.

name: GDELT
specific_judgment: GDELT actor/date/location records can propose incidents for comparison with UCDP, but an unmatched machine event is not an omitted fatality.

name: ICEWS event data
specific_judgment: ICEWS can identify a claimed actor interaction absent from ACLED, conditional on both recording the same event type and geography.

name: ReliefWeb API
specific_judgment: ReliefWeb republishes upstream reports; distinguish original evidence from duplicate publication.

name: Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX)
specific_judgment: A specified HDX displacement resource may supply local origin/destination needed for W02; dataset IDs alone describe a catalog object.

name: GDACS
specific_judgment: GDACS hazard footprints and alerts are model outputs; event severity and actual local damage require independent observations.

name: EM-DAT International Disaster Database
specific_judgment: EM-DAT disaster inclusion thresholds and aggregate deaths differ from local incident records; totals do not create detailed exposure maps.

name: Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem
specific_judgment: Imagery is an auxiliary observation; specific site, usable acquisition date and clouds must be established.

name: NASA Earthdata CMR API
specific_judgment: CMR granule time/platform/footprint can identify independent imagery to check a fire alert, but the catalog footprint is not observed burning.

name: USGS Landsat data
specific_judgment: Historical imagery requires repeat acquisitions and compatible resolution before a change-detection test.

name: NASA FIRMS active-fire data
specific_judgment: FIRMS thermal detections may indicate industrial heat or agricultural burning; a pixel alert is neither a precise burned footprint nor proof of arson.

name: Google Earth Engine public data catalogue
specific_judgment: Earth Engine asset IDs can reproduce a forest-loss overlay when the exact asset version and script are retained.

name: Global Forest Watch Open Data Portal/API
specific_judgment: Forest-loss products measure a defined canopy-change variable; product revisions, seasonality and nonhuman causes must be separated from concession responsibility.

name: EITI API and open data
specific_judgment: EITI reconciliation requires payer/payee/project/payment-stream/year/currency consistency; country disclosures vary in completeness and accounting basis.

name: EITI beneficial-ownership disclosures
specific_judgment: Beneficial-ownership disclosures vary by implementing country; percentage and verification evidence are necessary before a blocking-rule calculation.

name: Global Energy Monitor trackers
specific_judgment: GEM asset status and owner fields are research estimates with project-specific vintages; operation and retirement claims need actual unit evidence.

name: Climate TRACE
specific_judgment: Climate TRACE estimates are modeled; shared upstream data and uncertain attribution prevent treating every discrepancy as independent underreporting.

name: ResourceContracts
specific_judgment: ResourceContracts original clauses can define obligations, but amendments, effective dates and project/entity identities must be verified.

name: OpenStreetMap and Overpass API
specific_judgment: OSM changesets may help locate an industrial site for an ECHO record; map editing time is not construction or operating time.

name: Wikidata Query Service and dumps
specific_judgment: A Wikidata external identifier could bridge a listed organization to a registry, while its QID remains a community assertion.

name: Natural Earth
specific_judgment: Natural Earth country codes can display trade totals; its generalized polygons cannot decide whether an asset crossed a border.

name: JRC Global Surface Water
specific_judgment: Surface-water extent changes need seasonally comparable imagery; cloud, reservoir operations and drought can mimic project effects.

name: OpenFEC API
specific_judgment: FEC donor strings are not stable person IDs; employer/occupation and address corroboration cannot replace exact identity or establish influence.

name: US Senate Lobbying Disclosure data
specific_judgment: US lobbying reports aggregate issues and clients; a broad policy code is not evidence of a particular procurement intervention.

name: FARA eFile and bulk data
specific_judgment: FARA principal/agent agreements can establish the services relationship; legal authorization and foreign-principal identity must be read from documents.

name: EU Transparency Register
specific_judgment: EU Transparency interests and organization identifiers need the exact legislative procedure; registration does not show that a requested amendment was adopted.

name: Canada Registry of Lobbyists open data
specific_judgment: Canadian lobbying subject and designated official records require exact communication dates and office identity; co-location is not a meeting.

name: UK Political Finance Online
specific_judgment: UK entity/person donor categories and Electoral Commission reporting periods matter; shared ownership does not automatically combine legal donor status.

name: European Parliament Open Data Portal
specific_judgment: A recorded member vote on an identified EU procedure can test whether the adopted provision matches a publicly described position.

name: Elections Canada political-finance data
specific_judgment: Elections Canada contributors and campaign entities require election-period and personal identity resolution; corporate name overlap is not a permitted donor match.

name: Congress.gov API
specific_judgment: A bill reported as passed can be checked against the authenticated enrolled/public-law text to distinguish a proposal from the operative measure.

name: GovInfo API
specific_judgment: GovInfo package and bill identifiers can supply authoritative text for a status claim; document publication alone does not establish commencement or implementation.

name: Federal Register API
specific_judgment: Federal Register RIN/docket and publication type distinguish proposals from final rules; effects may begin after publication or be stayed.

name: EUR-Lex data reuse services
specific_judgment: EUR-Lex CELEX/procedure identifiers and consolidated versions distinguish adopted text from amendments; legal applicability requires the operative version.

name: HUDOC
specific_judgment: HUDOC application numbers and decision type must be retained; inadmissibility and merits judgments cannot be counted as equivalent rights violations.

name: CourtListener and RECAP
specific_judgment: CourtListener/RECAP coverage depends on acquired filings; docket absence cannot prove no litigation and complaints do not establish facts.

name: PACER
specific_judgment: PACER access charges remain outside new spending authority; docket-party identity and procedural outcome must be read in permitted existing documents.

name: ICC Legal Tools Database
specific_judgment: ICC Legal Tools documents may quote allegations or evidence; document identity is not a finding against every named person.

name: UN Digital Library APIs
specific_judgment: UN document symbols may connect a state arms-control statement with that state’s reported transfers; a vote does not itself establish a transfer restriction.

name: Internet Archive Wayback Machine APIs
specific_judgment: Archive capture time is not the publication or underlying event date; missing captures cannot prove absence.

name: Common Crawl
specific_judgment: An exact URL and digest can establish that two archives captured the same published claim, helping preserve evidence of later changes.

name: DocumentCloud
specific_judgment: A DocumentCloud filing could be checked against the docket’s exact attachment to authenticate a publicly important quoted document.

name: MuckRock API
specific_judgment: A request log reporting a final response can be reconciled to the actual agency response for the same case to test a misleading closure description.

name: CIA Freedom of Information Act Reading Room
specific_judgment: Two released copies carrying the same original document number may show substantively different redactions of a consequential passage.

name: US State Department FOIA Virtual Reading Room
specific_judgment: Agency case identifiers and letters can verify what was actually released in response to a logged request.

name: UK National Archives Discovery API
specific_judgment: An archival catalogue reference can corroborate creator/date provenance for a declassified-document claim.

name: National Security Archive Virtual Reading Room
specific_judgment: A curated archive may preserve a second release of a CIA document; its selection does not establish the complete declassification history.

name: Media Cloud Search API
specific_judgment: Media story URLs and ad dates could describe attention around a campaign, but collection counts cannot establish total reach or paid influence.

name: Google Fact Check Tools API
specific_judgment: A fact-check URL and claim may identify an advertisement repeating a previously assessed factual assertion.

name: Meta Ad Library
specific_judgment: Meta political-ad archives report spend ranges and disclaimers, not a complete payee ledger; agency-funded and in-kind ads need reconciliation.

name: Google Ads Transparency Center
specific_judgment: Google advertiser verification and creative archives are not complete political spending; displayed dates and payer identity need documentation.

name: World Bank Documents & Reports API
specific_judgment: World Bank project ID links document and project indexes; text retrieval confirmed, substantive delivery comparison still auxiliary.

name: OONI data and API
specific_judgment: OONI supports censorship-specific tests rather than general outage inference; control false positives and geography.

name: RIPEstat Data API
specific_judgment: Historical RIPE attribution must honor returned observation times and warnings; the saved AS21928 response was stale for the requested interval.

name: Censys Search
specific_judgment: A passively indexed service banner may suggest that a public-service host exposes a product affected by a known exploited CVE.

name: CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog
specific_judgment: CISA CVEs identify known exploitation, not deployment on an agency network; previous schema HTTP403 is an access failure, not proof of absence.

name: NVD vulnerability API and feeds
specific_judgment: NVD affected-product/version logic can refine a CVE test but missing or disputed entries and backported patches require vendor confirmation.

name: ICANN RDAP
specific_judgment: RDAP may redact registrants and show current rather than historic data; domain registration is not complete operational control.

name: Certificate Transparency logs
specific_judgment: Certificate fingerprints and domains support issuance history; certificates can be delegated, reused or issued without the inferred site ownership.

name: World Bank Indicators API
specific_judgment: Country-year development indicators can contextualize aid allocations once indicator vintages and recipient codes match.

name: IMF Data APIs
specific_judgment: A specified IMF external-position series could be compared with BIS reporter/counterparty aggregates for a narrowly matched financial claim.

name: BIS Data Portal
specific_judgment: BIS banking exposure totals cannot be joined to individual sanctioned counterparties; they may support a country-level reconciliation only.

name: ECB Data Portal API
specific_judgment: ECB institution-sector series and Canadian OSFI bank statements do not share institutions or reporting scope without a specific cross-border claim.

name: UNCTAD Data Hub
specific_judgment: UNCTAD sector/product indicators can contextualize a Comtrade trade-route anomaly but may derive from the same underlying trade statistics.

name: Global Human Settlement Layer
specific_judgment: GHSL settlement/population products differ by variable and epoch; built-up area is not a current resident count.

name: World Settlement Footprint Evolution
specific_judgment: Settlement Footprint Evolution maps detected built extent through time; sensor/model changes and temporal support constrain demolition claims.

name: WorldPop spatial data API
specific_judgment: WorldPop product selection fixes geography, year and whether values are counts or density; model output does not prove exposure or current occupancy.

name: Meta High Resolution Settlement Layer
specific_judgment: HRSL allocates population to mapped settlements; underlying census vintage and excluded structures affect local estimates.

name: Meta Relative Wealth Index
specific_judgment: Relative Wealth Index is a modeled relative score, not household income or a poverty headcount; geographic sampling and aid-location precision matter.

name: Meta Social Connectedness Index
specific_judgment: Social-connectedness geography pairs cannot identify campaign operatives or individual ties behind election results.

name: Google Open Buildings
specific_judgment: Google V3 excludes US mainland and Canada; listed Caribbean territories do not make its coverage global. Exact tile, imagery age and confidence remain gates.

name: Google Open Buildings 2.5D Temporal
specific_judgment: Google temporal-building products have their own regional coverage and annual model limitations; do not inherit V3 footprint coverage or interpret height as occupancy.

name: Microsoft Global ML Building Footprints
specific_judgment: Microsoft footprint country releases can support covered US sites, but release dates, source imagery and false detections require local checks.

name: GlobalBuildingAtlas
specific_judgment: GlobalBuildingAtlas height/volume estimates need local accuracy and vintage validation; geometric volume cannot directly count residents or hazardous contents.

name: Overture Maps Foundation data
specific_judgment: Overture geometry/source references could reconcile duplicated facility locations, not legal ownership of those facilities.

name: Foursquare Open Source Places
specific_judgment: A places record could help check whether a disclosed supplier address houses a plausible facility.

name: OpenAddresses
specific_judgment: Geocoding a recipient address can prioritize dubious-address checks but proves neither occupancy nor supplier legitimacy.

name: geoBoundaries API
specific_judgment: Administrative shapes can support election/aid allocation comparison only when election reporting units match that boundary vintage.

name: GeoNames web services and dumps
specific_judgment: Place-name variants can suggest coordinates for an incident but must not convert ambiguous names into precise event points.

name: Who's On First
specific_judgment: Concordances and hierarchy can bridge administrative naming changes for a longitudinal exposure estimate.

name: European Space Agency WorldCover
specific_judgment: WorldCover class labels and mapping years need accuracy controls; a class change does not identify the land user or legal permission.

name: Dynamic World
specific_judgment: Dynamic World class probabilities vary with imagery and season; a single prediction cannot establish permanent conversion.

name: AlphaEarth Foundations Satellite Embeddings
specific_judgment: Embedding shifts inside a land deal can prioritize image inspection but do not establish clearing, crop conversion or illegal activity.

name: OpenLandMap
specific_judgment: Soil/land properties may inform a water-use model, but composite reference periods cannot directly test current project practices.

name: SoilGrids API
specific_judgment: SoilGrids property estimates and Quebec geochemical concentrations may use different matrices and depths, preventing a direct contamination test.

name: Global Food Security-support Analysis Data
specific_judgment: Cropland products constrain cultivation claims only in their documented reference years and resolution; mixed pixels do not establish crop ownership.

name: MapBiomas collections
specific_judgment: MapBiomas regional collections use different legends/versions; compare compatible classes and independent observations before attributing clearing.

name: Global Mangrove Watch
specific_judgment: Mangrove-change maps can flag coastal ecosystem loss, but tidal state, resolution and local validation determine whether the change is real.

name: HydroSHEDS
specific_judgment: Drainage topology is a necessary auxiliary for downstream tailings scenarios, not a hazard footprint.

name: Global Dam Watch
specific_judgment: Dam locations/capacity do not define inundation or downstream tailings impact; connected terrain and an engineering scenario are necessary.

name: Aqueduct Water Risk Atlas data
specific_judgment: A fossil-fuel asset in a stressed basin suggests water-planning questions; Aqueduct risk is not the asset’s withdrawal or permit compliance.

name: FAO WaPOR
specific_judgment: WaPOR water productivity/evapotranspiration is geography- and model-specific; hectares and crop-season definitions must match the project claim.

name: OpenET API
specific_judgment: OpenET requires compatible geographic coverage, credential/access route and ensemble uncertainty; modeled evapotranspiration is not a metered withdrawal.

name: GRACE Tellus gravity and groundwater data
specific_judgment: GRACE basin-scale mass estimates cannot attribute facility-level water extraction; hydrologic balance and scale bridge missing.

name: CHIRPS rainfall
specific_judgment: Rainfall anomalies can test whether surface-water decline near a concession persists after accounting for drought.

name: NASA IMERG precipitation
specific_judgment: IMERG timing can contextualize a flood warning but product-run revisions must not replace information available before the event.

name: Microsoft Planetary Computer
specific_judgment: Planetary Computer can provide reproducible imagery access; it is not an independent observation from the same Sentinel acquisition.

name: Earth Search STAC
specific_judgment: Earth Search may mirror a Landsat scene used elsewhere; duplicate access does not add observation confidence.

name: Radiant MLHub
specific_judgment: Labeled imagery could validate waste-site detection only if the labels cover the target geography and definitions.

name: Source Cooperative
specific_judgment: A hosted building-footprint collection may aid settlement checks, but repository/object keys do not imply a new measurement.

name: OpenAerialMap API
specific_judgment: Dated aerial imagery can check a UNOSAT damage classification for a particular structure.

name: Umbra Open Data Program
specific_judgment: Open SAR imagery may reveal structural change through clouds for a documented event.

name: Vantor Open Data Program (formerly Maxar)
specific_judgment: Crisis imagery may independently assess a claimed destroyed structure if acquisition dates and license permit.

name: Mapillary API
specific_judgment: Street-level imagery might document an accessible abandoned-mine hazard at a mapped site.

name: NASA Black Marble
specific_judgment: Black Marble corrections reduce but do not eliminate cloud/moon/fire artifacts; post-conflict radiance loss is not uniquely a power outage.

name: Earth Observation Group VIIRS Nighttime Lights
specific_judgment: VIIRS composites mask/filter observations differently from daily lights; stable temporal aggregation is necessary before trend comparisons.

name: Light Every Night
specific_judgment: Light Every Night provides another night-light access path; establish sensor/product independence before combining with VIIRS evidence.

name: Small-Area Global Elections (SAGE)
specific_judgment: SAGE electoral boundaries and election dates are essential for allocation analysis; mismatched geography or different governing jurisdictions defeats inference.

name: Copernicus Climate Data Store API
specific_judgment: Reanalysis wind variables can contextualize an air-quality anomaly but are not facility-scale plume measurements.

name: European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts Open Data
specific_judgment: ECMWF forecasts must be the archived run actually available before the event; retrospective analyses cannot establish what officials knew.

name: NOAA Climate Data Online API
specific_judgment: A station observation can check what actually occurred after an archived forecast for that location.

name: USGS Earthquake Catalog API
specific_judgment: USGS earthquake event IDs/magnitudes may be revised; epicenter is not a complete shaking or damage footprint.

name: European-Mediterranean Seismological Centre FDSN services
specific_judgment: EMSC and USGS may share seismic inputs; matching records are not independent damage evidence and event revisions require tracking.

name: NASA Global Landslide Catalog
specific_judgment: Global Landslide reports are presence-biased; no catalog record does not prove no landslide near a project.

name: IBTrACS tropical cyclone archive
specific_judgment: IBTrACS best tracks are retrospective syntheses; distinguish them from warnings issued before a response decision.

name: Global Flood Awareness System data
specific_judgment: GloFAS basin-scale forecasts need local hydrologic connection and lead time; coarse hazard does not establish site-level flood depth.

name: UNOSAT products and damage assessments
specific_judgment: UNOSAT damage classes depend on observation date and imagery; assessments may share the same source image as another proposed corroborator.

name: HDX Humanitarian API
specific_judgment: HDX HAPI can standardize displacement indicators but may repeat IOM observations.

name: OpenAQ API
specific_judgment: OpenAQ station readings require pollutant, averaging interval and quality controls; monitor location alone cannot identify the emitting facility.

name: EDGAR emissions database
specific_judgment: A gridded EDGAR cell minus nearby GHGRP reports is not an estimate of unreported facility emissions.

name: Carbon Mapper Data Platform API
specific_judgment: Carbon Mapper API account/token is an actual access gate; instantaneous plume uncertainty and source persistence must not be confused with annual inventory mass.

name: MethaneSAT data portal and cloud data
specific_judgment: MethaneSAT availability and coverage cannot be presumed from the catalog; verify current accessible products before assigning testability.

name: NASA EMIT greenhouse-gas products
specific_judgment: EMIT plume detections depend on overpass and retrieval conditions; a nondetection is not evidence that a facility emits no methane.

name: US EPA Greenhouse Gas Reporting Program
specific_judgment: GHGRP facility/pollutant/process/year scope and thresholds matter; an advertised EIA crosswalk does not itself validate one matched unit.

name: US EPA Toxics Release Inventory
specific_judgment: TRI releases include specific media and estimation methods; annual reported mass is not a nearby monitor concentration or unrestricted all-pollutant inventory.

name: European Industrial Emissions Portal
specific_judgment: European industrial reporting boundaries, pollutants and thresholds differ by regime; exact facility/subfacility and reporting-year matches are necessary.

name: Canada National Pollutant Release Inventory
specific_judgment: NPRI facility identifiers and reported pollutants support Canadian site work; release estimates and reporting thresholds prevent absence or dose conclusions.

name: UK Pollution Inventory
specific_judgment: UK Pollution Inventory coverage must match the responsible environmental jurisdiction and actual pollutant; it is not a universal UK facility census.

name: Australia National Pollutant Inventory
specific_judgment: Australian NPI substance estimates and facility coverage differ from direct measurements; Google V3 buildings do not supply Australian coverage.

name: Carbon Majors database
specific_judgment: A producer’s attributed emissions estimate can be reconciled to its disclosed production to test the arithmetic behind a major climate claim.

name: Global Registry of Fossil Fuels
specific_judgment: Fossil-fuel reserves/resources and project ownership are not current production or water-use observations; verify asset status and boundary.

name: Global Tailings Portal
specific_judgment: Tailings attributes and location uncertainty require original disclosures; dam classification and potential runout need engineering evidence.

name: Global Plastics Watch
specific_judgment: Plastics Watch sites are machine detections; confirm actual waste before alleging disposal or linking operators.

name: Land Matrix API
specific_judgment: Land Matrix deals may be announced or stalled; effective rights and implemented footprints are needed for forest/water/cultivation tests.

name: Open Supply Hub
specific_judgment: Open Supply Hub facilities need verification of brand relationship dates and actual production, not mere address/name similarity.

name: Protected Planet API
specific_judgment: Protected Planet designations have effective dates and varied restrictions; polygon overlap does not alone establish illegal development.

name: GBIF occurrence API
specific_judgment: GBIF occurrence points can be historical, uncertain or obscured; presence can guide assessment but absence cannot establish species absence.

name: UNHCR Refugee Data Finder API
specific_judgment: Country-year displacement totals cannot identify local incident effects without disaggregation and reporting coverage.

name: IOM Displacement Tracking Matrix
specific_judgment: IOM displacement rounds distinguish stock, movements and sites; origin precision and repeat movements matter for conflict linkage.

name: IDMC Global Internal Displacement Database
specific_judgment: IDMC new displacements may be compared with an IOM episode only after determining whether both count movements or unique people.

name: WHO Global Health Observatory OData API
specific_judgment: WHO modeled health trends may incorporate DHS surveys; agreement cannot independently verify health-program effectiveness.

name: DHS Program API
specific_judgment: DHS regional subgroup estimates can challenge overprecise national claims when survey weights and uncertainty are respected.

name: ILOSTAT bulk and API services
specific_judgment: Labour-sector aggregates could contextualize an aid program’s promised jobs but cannot identify the project’s jobs or causal effect.

name: Varieties of Democracy dataset
specific_judgment: V-Dem score changes alongside conflict events do not establish that a government caused a specific abuse.

name: Manifesto Project API
specific_judgment: Manifesto coding can locate a pledge but the original text must provide a measurable promise and deadline.

name: ParlGov database
specific_judgment: ParlGov cabinet/party histories establish some governing authority; portfolio control, coalitions and subnational responsibility still need separate evidence.

name: Quality of Government datasets
specific_judgment: Quality of Government may reproduce V-Dem indicators; correlating the copies is circular.

name: Aid Worker Security Database
specific_judgment: Aid Worker Security incidents are selected documented attacks; matching a project nearby does not establish its personnel or security responsibility.

name: ACAPS API
specific_judgment: ACAPS analysis can contextualize disaster severity and response priorities but cannot independently corroborate its source event records.

name: Correlates of War datasets
specific_judgment: Correlates of War and UCDP disagreement could expose different counting of interstate violence but is not an unreported war by itself.

name: UN Peacekeeping data
specific_judgment: Mission personnel-months near a period of aid-worker attacks raise protection-capacity questions, not evidence of failure by a contingent.

name: CORDIS European research projects
specific_judgment: CORDIS project/grant identifiers can anchor EU funded research; project objectives and extensions determine meaningful milestones.

name: NIH RePORTER API
specific_judgment: NIH grant numbers may have supplements and multiple studies; match actual acknowledgements and project periods before outcome checks.

name: CMS Open Payments
specific_judgment: Open Payments recipient identifiers distinguish individuals and institutions; general, research and ownership payments have different implications.

name: ClinicalTrials.gov API
specific_judgment: Current ClinicalTrials records are not necessarily prospective protocols; retrieve version history and preserve registration-versus-study chronology.

name: OpenAlex API
specific_judgment: OpenAlex work and author IDs help discovery; entity disambiguation errors and deposited metadata cannot substantiate undisclosed funding alone.

name: Crossref REST API
specific_judgment: Crossref DOI/clinical-trial fields can directly link deposited references, but missing fields are not missing registration and linkage says nothing about integrity.

name: ORCID Public API
specific_judgment: ORCID is partly self-asserted; author identity bridge needs corroboration, not guilt by affiliation.

name: PatentsView API
specific_judgment: PatentsView inventor/assignee IDs need disambiguation and filing dates; an acknowledgement is stronger than same inventor for linking a public grant.

name: EPO Open Patent Services
specific_judgment: EPO patent family and publication identifiers must distinguish priorities, grants and legal status; a published application is not an enforceable patent everywhere.

name: OpenFIGI API
specific_judgment: FIGI identifies an instrument, not its ultimate legal owner; issuer and dated beneficial-owner bridges are required.

name: US Energy Information Administration API
specific_judgment: EPA advertises an EIA facility crosswalk; generation/emissions comparisons require unit boundaries and fuel mix.

name: ENTSO-E Transparency Platform API
specific_judgment: Unit generation may test purported closure after EIC-to-asset crosswalk, token and actual-versus-forecast checks.

name: MarineCadastre.gov AIS data
specific_judgment: MarineCadastre AIS has US-focused time/coverage and MMSI identity limits; exact ship crosswalk and observation quality are mandatory.

name: PeeringDB API
specific_judgment: PeeringDB is contributor-maintained network/facility information; listing an organization does not prove operational control during a historic outage.

name: RIPE Atlas API
specific_judgment: RIPE Atlas probe availability and measurement configuration shape outages; only existing public measurements are in scope, no active testing was launched.

name: IODA Internet Outage API
specific_judgment: IODA signals use distinct reachability/BGP/telescope observations; one anomaly alone cannot establish government shutdown or precise local impact.

name: Cloudflare Radar API
specific_judgment: Cloudflare Radar visibility reflects its traffic population; changes may reflect routing/customer shifts rather than complete national internet loss.

name: CAIDA BGPStream
specific_judgment: BGPStream path changes identify routing observations, not end-user traffic interruption or actor intent; collector coverage matters.

name: Government of Canada Open Government CKAN API
specific_judgment: The federal catalogue can identify versioned procurement resources for reproducibility; metadata availability is not award completeness.

name: Statistics Canada Web Data Service
specific_judgment: Statistics Canada vectors can preserve the exact provincial mineral-production series used in a reconciliation.

name: Statistics Canada Census Profile Web Data Service
specific_judgment: Census profiles carry geographic vintage and suppression; local exposure estimates need matched boundaries and cannot turn area averages into individual facts.

name: Statistics Canada Reference Data as a Service
specific_judgment: Industry classifications contextualize companies; category overlap alone is no consequential hypothesis.

name: Bank of Canada Valet API
specific_judgment: A stated Bank of Canada exchange-rate convention can harmonize extractive payments disclosed in different currencies.

name: Office of the Superintendent of Financial Institutions open financial data
specific_judgment: OSFI bank tables have regulatory scopes, consolidation and period definitions; aggregate concentration does not identify fund counterparties.

name: CanadaBuys procurement and contracting datasets
specific_judgment: CanadaBuys notices and awards need lifecycle keys and amendments; an announced maximum amount is not expenditure.

name: Federal proactive publication — contracts
specific_judgment: Proactive contract publication has thresholds, amendments and disclosure lags; missing rows cannot prove no contract or complete procurement coverage.

name: Federal proactive publication — grants and contributions
specific_judgment: Grant contribution commitments and recipient fiscal periods differ from delivery and outcomes; match the exact funded project and conditions.

name: Federal proactive disclosure — travel and hospitality
specific_judgment: Travel/hospitality claims identify reimbursed expenses, not every attendee or meeting; dates and named officials require corroboration.

name: House of Commons of Canada open data
specific_judgment: Voting and donations need member-to-recipient, election-cycle and legislative-subject links; sequence does not prove influence.

name: LEGISinfo bills open data
specific_judgment: Bill/session identifiers can prevent mistaking a proposed lobbying target for an enacted or effective requirement.

name: Canada Gazette RSS feeds
specific_judgment: Canada Gazette stages distinguish proposed regulations, final instruments and notices; effective dates and enabling provisions control applicability.

name: Supreme Court of Canada judgments feeds
specific_judgment: Supreme Court case identifiers and disposition can confirm appellate outcomes, not facts alleged in every referenced lower-court case.

name: Federal Court decisions RSS feed
specific_judgment: Federal Court feed is a selected discovery route, not a complete docket; OIC compliance tests require actual review/stay proceedings and service dates.

name: Health Canada Drug Product Database API and bulk data
specific_judgment: Health Canada drug numbers, ingredients and market status need formulation/indication crosswalks; marketed status alone does not show trial results.

name: Spectrum Management System authorization data extract
specific_judgment: Spectrum authorizations relate to licensee, frequency and station parameters; they do not prove actual transmission or fulfill every funded connectivity claim.

name: Canadian Register of Large Vessels API
specific_judgment: Canadian vessel official numbers differ from IMO and MMSI; ownership and registry status need event-date confirmation.

name: Transportation Safety Board multimodal occurrence data
specific_judgment: TSB occurrence IDs and vehicle identifiers locate safety events; allegations, causal findings and recommendations are separate evidentiary stages.

name: Federal Contaminated Sites Inventory
specific_judgment: Contaminated-site suspicion/classification/remediation status does not measure current exposure; use site-specific assessment and dates.

name: Canadian Impact Assessment Registry assessment inventory
specific_judgment: Assessment inventory is not the complete project footprint or final approval conditions; retrieve the actual assessment decision and amendments.

name: Canada Energy Regulator pipeline incident data
specific_judgment: CER pipeline incidents have reporting definitions and location precision; facility ownership and consequence measures need event-specific verification.

name: GEO.ca data-cube SpatioTemporal Asset Catalog API
specific_judgment: A GEO.ca item may provide imagery around a contaminated site; the catalog footprint does not indicate contamination.

name: Statistics Canada 2025 census-subdivision boundary service
specific_judgment: Census subdivision IDs can support population estimates around a site only for a compatible census geography vintage.

name: Toronto Stock Exchange / TMX Datalinx market-data products
specific_judgment: Market reference access and price/history rights must be confirmed before event comparisons.

name: SEDAR+ public issuer and filing search
specific_judgment: SEDAR issuer filings are primary texts but access/search and document version need checking; issuer IDs do not automatically identify every subsidiary or property.

name: System for Electronic Disclosure by Insiders and national registrant systems
specific_judgment: Insider holding changes versus filings require transaction codes, amendments and corporate actions; not an insider-trading allegation.

name: Ontario Securities Commission open-data inventory
specific_judgment: OSC inventory status can identify missing or discontinued disclosure products, but dataset names are not evidence about issuers.

name: Ontario Securities Commission exempt-market distributions
specific_judgment: Exempt-distribution amounts are not comprehensive financial statements; full issuer filings required.

name: Ontario Securities Commission Investment Fund Survey data
specific_judgment: OSC fund survey aggregates can support systemic context, but confidentiality and population differences prevent named bank-to-fund linkage.

name: Ontario Securities Commission women on boards and executive positions data
specific_judgment: Historical issuer-year board statistics can be checked against that issuer’s filed circular to identify material extraction or disclosure inconsistencies.

name: Ontario Securities Commission regulatory action against registrants
specific_judgment: OSC aggregate regulatory-action counts cannot identify a registrant also subject to a SEC action.

name: Extractive Sector Transparency Measures Act data portal
specific_judgment: ESTMA payer/payee/project/stream definitions and currency conversions govern reconciliation; disclosed payments are not inherently facility coordinates.

name: Principal Mineral Areas, Producing Mines, and Oil and Gas Fields (900A)
specific_judgment: 900A mine/field inventory provides site context and status, not complete owner history or current physical output.

name: Top 100 Exploration Projects
specific_judgment: Top exploration projects are selected and date-specific; disappearance is not project failure without criteria and follow-up evidence.

name: Critical minerals advanced projects, mines and processing facilities
specific_judgment: Critical mineral advanced-project lists use stage definitions; inclusion is not proof of production, reserves or subsidy delivery.

name: Natural Resources Canada Major Projects Inventory
specific_judgment: Major Projects Inventory values and status are estimates with thresholds; match project components before reconciling grants or issuer totals.

name: Statistics Canada production of metallic minerals, monthly
specific_judgment: An issuer’s claimed physical provincial production cannot exceed a complete same-commodity provincial total if units, periods and scope truly match.

name: Nunavut mineral tenure suite
specific_judgment: Nunavut tenure instruments and holder identity require effective dates and surface-right distinctions; polygon overlap does not establish operations.

name: British Columbia mineral, placer and coal tenure spatial view
specific_judgment: BC mineral/placer/coal titles have distinct rights and statuses; title holder is not automatically the operator or surface-land owner.

name: British Columbia MINFILE mineral occurrence database
specific_judgment: Mineral occurrence geology is not an economic reserve or proof of extraction; dated permits and technical reports required.

name: British Columbia mine permit boundaries
specific_judgment: BC permit boundaries describe permitted areas; they do not necessarily define all disturbance or contain operator/ownership history.

name: British Columbia permitted mine inspection reports summary
specific_judgment: BC inspection summaries require the original report and inspected operator/date; absence of an entry is not proof of no inspections.

name: Ontario Geological Survey OGSEarth
specific_judgment: OGSEarth claim/site IDs can suggest the area to inspect, but the mining-claims system must establish current tenure.

name: Ontario Abandoned Mines Information System
specific_judgment: Ontario abandoned-mine points and hazard classifications may be historic; current remediation and public access require site-specific verification.

name: Ontario Mineral Inventory
specific_judgment: An Ontario occurrence can identify geology behind a promoter’s statement, but absence of a reserve in the inventory does not disprove a new resource.

name: Ontario mining claims dataset
specific_judgment: Ontario mining-claim identifiers and status can support tenure checks; claim ownership and actual mine operation remain different observations.

name: Québec mining activities
specific_judgment: Quebec activity locations/status can help distinguish active mines from geological occurrences; operator and permit evidence must be dated.

name: Québec mineral occurrences, deposits, mines and quarries
specific_judgment: Quebec occurrence status can be compared to mining activities to resolve which mapped deposit is actually operating.

name: Québec geochemistry
specific_judgment: Geochemical samples require method, matrix, QA and location; concentrations cannot establish population exposure.

name: Québec mineral potential
specific_judgment: A mineral-potential zone cannot substantiate a company claim of discovery or economic reserves.

name: Alberta metallic and industrial minerals agreements
specific_judgment: Alberta mineral agreements convey specified rights; an agreement polygon is not an operating plant or blanket environmental authorization.

name: Alberta Energy Regulator spatial and incident data
specific_judgment: AER incidents and regulated assets require stable licence/operator crosswalks; current ownership cannot establish responsibility at the incident date.

name: Saskatchewan mineral dispositions
specific_judgment: Saskatchewan dispositions may cover different rights and stages; legal holder identity and effective dates precede any development attribution.

name: Saskatchewan Mineral Deposits Index
specific_judgment: Deposit IDs and mapsheets can locate geology within a Saskatchewan disposition, not prove that its holder discovered or owns all minerals described.

name: Manitoba Integrated Mining and Quarrying System map service
specific_judgment: Manitoba map layers mix mining/quarry rights; match instrument type and legal identifiers rather than treating all polygons as active mines.

name: New Brunswick mineral occurrences service
specific_judgment: A New Brunswick occurrence location could help inspect an issuer’s project description, but occurrence records contain no established owner bridge.

name: Nova Scotia Mineral Rights Database
specific_judgment: Nova Scotia mineral rights identify licences/leases with dates; those rights do not validate claimed resources in an occurrence database.

name: Nova Scotia Mineral Occurrence Database
specific_judgment: Nova Scotia occurrence/sample IDs can support geology on a mineral-right polygon when sample origin and dates are clear.

name: Newfoundland and Labrador mineral exploration statistics
specific_judgment: Historical Newfoundland exploration totals may contextualize a claimed boom; stale extracts cannot measure current major-project activity.

name: Yukon surveyed mineral-claim polygons
specific_judgment: Yukon surveyed claims may be historical geometries; current standing and operator activity require the authoritative title record.

name: Northwest Territories Mineral Showings Database
specific_judgment: NWT showing coordinates can locate early evidence near an advanced project but cannot validate its reserve or development status.

name: British Columbia Data Catalogue API
specific_judgment: BC catalogue resource IDs can locate mine inspection releases and distinguish refreshes from inspection dates.

name: Ontario Data Catalogue API
specific_judgment: Ontario catalogue can identify the current abandoned-mine inventory resource; catalogue timestamps cannot establish remediation.

name: Données Québec CKAN API
specific_judgment: Quebec catalogue can identify laboratory/geochemistry dictionaries needed for contamination screening.

name: Alberta Open Government catalogue API
specific_judgment: Alberta catalogue can locate regulator incident layers but cannot independently verify an incident count.

name: Saskatchewan GeoHub
specific_judgment: Saskatchewan GeoHub item/layer IDs can expose the authoritative tenure service needed for a deposit overlay.

name: GeoNB ArcGIS REST services directory
specific_judgment: GeoNB feature and layer IDs can identify the occurrence map source but need explicit provenance and reuse terms.

name: Nova Scotia Open Data API
specific_judgment: Nova Scotia Socrata resource identifiers can preserve the mineral-right dataset version used in a claim check.

name: Open Data Newfoundland and Labrador
specific_judgment: Newfoundland portal revision metadata can flag a stale exploration extract, not establish that no exploration occurred.

name: Prince Edward Island Open Data
specific_judgment: PEI ArcGIS catalog may contain local site or land-use information relevant to a contaminated-site case; item IDs alone do not prove such records exist.

name: Government of Yukon open-data CKAN API
specific_judgment: Yukon package/resource IDs can stabilize references to released request documents; package presence is not a complete response log.

name: Northwest Territories Open Data CKAN API
specific_judgment: NWT catalogue can locate supporting mineral-showing documents but cannot independently corroborate the same underlying geology.

name: Information and Privacy Commissioner of Ontario access-order RSS feed
specific_judgment: Ontario access-order RSS identifies published decisions, not all requests; read the order and exact institution before comparing annual compliance.

name: Office of the Privacy Commissioner of Canada RSS feeds
specific_judgment: An OPC feed can identify a named privacy finding involving a public-interest organization; titles and names cannot establish sanctions identity or the substance of a ruling.

name: Canadian Human Rights Tribunal decisions RSS feed
specific_judgment: Canadian Human Rights Tribunal decisions must distinguish procedural rulings and final merits; federal jurisdiction differs from Tribunals Ontario.

name: Office of the Information Commissioner of Canada decisions database
specific_judgment: Information orders need exact terms, service dates and court review/stay evidence before judging compliance.

name: Canadian Human Rights Commission dispute-resolution statistics
specific_judgment: CHRC dispute-resolution aggregates cannot be reconciled directly to tribunal judgments as though every complaint becomes a judgment.

name: Ontario freedom-of-information compliance data
specific_judgment: Ontario FOI compliance statistics require consistent institution/reporting-year and closed-request definitions; selective orders do not form a representative denominator.

name: Newfoundland and Labrador access-to-information requests dataset
specific_judgment: Historical Newfoundland requests and Yukon completed cases have different periods and universes; comparing raw completion counts cannot rank transparency.

name: Tribunals Ontario decisions-issued workbooks
specific_judgment: Tribunals Ontario workbook cases are not the federal Canadian Human Rights Tribunal corpus; generic case/date fields do not create a shared jurisdiction.

name: Government of Yukon completed access-to-information registry
specific_judgment: Completed Yukon request packages can supply original documents for a substantive topic, but absence from a completed registry does not establish nonresponse.
